prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original hand-painted combat animation source sheet for warrior Luo Zhen, direction N, set A.
References: image1 portrait locks identity, costume/axe materials; image2 WEST set A locks original body scale and rendering. Generate a NEW anatomical viewpoint, not copies, rotations or mirrors.
Output: request native2048x2048 transparent PNG, never upscale. Exactly FOUR full independent character-plus-axe sprites in 2x2 row-major. Each complete sprite within its quadrant,35px transparent padding from every cell boundary. Compact axe/scarf silhouette so no cell overlap. Target anatomical hair-to-average shoe sole height450-550 actual pixels; if1254output retain approximately480px standing anatomy, not a smaller man. All poses same scale, stable foot anchor lower in each cell.
Direction: NORTH270°: directly toward the TOP of the screen, aim(0,-1); no left/right body heading.. EVERY pose shares this heading: head, torso, hips, boots and attack aim. STRICT FULL BACK VIEW: only back of brown head, nape, two ears, complete back armor and back coat panel visible. NO eyes, face, nose, mouth, front breastplate, or camera-facing cheek in ANY pose. Upright spine faces screen-up; shoulder axis horizontal, both toes point screen-up, shoes seen from rear/high angle. This is full rear anatomy newly drawn at fixed high camera.
Adult athletic man, short textured brown hair, navy #233b66 long light-armored coat with gold edging, silver #e0e6ef fitted shoulder/back/forearm/shin armor, vermilion #d6554e scarf with restrained tails, dark gloves and trousers. Huge gold-and-silver crescent rune axe with solid charcoal molten-rock inset and contained orange sunstone cracks/central gem; no detached floating rock props. Same recognizable costume, axe and man as portrait. Adult anatomy, no chibi. Bright hand-painted cartoon fantasy with volume, clean dark outlines, material shading. Fixed high oblique overhead near-isometric2.5D game camera; viewpoint changes around upright anatomy.
TL idle: combat-ready stance, side-held lowered diagonal axe, both feet visible.
TR walk_left: large natural stride along heading, character LEFT leg ahead and right leg behind, arms balance side-carried axe.
BL walk_right: opposite large stride along same heading, character RIGHT leg ahead and left leg behind; visibly distinct leg/arm phase.
BR basic_windup: two hands pull massive axe behind/over shoulder to charge heavy strike along heading; planted legs, torso naturally twists; head/feet remain aimed in that direction.
Constraints: exactly4 complete sprites, full hair/feet/hands/scarf/weapon. Same anatomy scale across poses. No background/floor/shadow, no external FX/glow/action arcs/motion trails, no labels/text, no extra people/props, no cropped weapon or body, no neighbor overlap. Small internal weapon light only.
landmark_method: Manual visual estimate in native absolute pixels. body_height measures visible anatomy from hair top to lowest shoe sole and excludes axe/scarf extent. foot is average expected ground projection of two soles, not lowest alpha pixel. Landmark accuracy is estimated conservatively; airborne shoe projection requires review.

layout_review.direction_identity_review: All four poses are pure back view with rear brown head/backplate/back coat, no face or front chest.
layout_review.notes: Native 1254 source requested as 2048. Principal sprites are independent alpha components. Axe/scarf and overhead release can cross nominal 627-pixel cell bounds. Component-aware isolation is necessary before runtime enablement.
layout_review.body_scale_risk: One built-in targeted scale edit applied to B; low stance and raised-arm poses have shorter visible anatomy. Foot row location differs from A; common ground-foot packing must align, without per-frame enlargement.
